name: Fantasy tables
description: Random tables for fantasy adventures: weather, travel, taverns, rumours, people and trinkets. Written for Fudger.

entities.name: Fantasy weather
entities.description: Today's weather in a temperate land.

entries.text: A storm with thunder; travel is slow and dangerous
Cold rain all day
Grey skies and a steady wind
Clear and mild
Warm sun, a light breeze
Thick fog until noon
Strange weather: a red sky, warm snow or a sudden hush

entities.name: Travel encounters
entities.description: Who or what the travellers meet on the road.

entries.text: A merchant with a broken cart wheel, offering a discount for help
Pilgrims singing on their way to a shrine
A toll gate run by [[1d4+1]] bored guards
A messenger on a tired horse, in a great hurry
Tracks leaving the road, fresh and heavy
A wandering tinker who knows the local gossip
The weather turns:
A traveller going the same way:

entities.name: Tavern events
entities.description: Something happening in the tavern tonight.

entries.text: A card game turns into an argument about cheating
A bard plays a song about one of the characters, with the facts wrong
The cook runs out of everything except stew
A stranger pays for everyone's drinks and leaves at once
Two old friends meet again and drink far too much
A notice goes up offering a reward for a lost dog
The floor gives way under a heavy table
A local champion challenges anyone to arm wrestling
Someone recognises a character from somewhere they would rather forget
A traveller sells maps; one of them looks real
The landlord asks for help with noises in the cellar
A wedding party arrives and takes over the place

entities.name: Rumours
entities.description: What people are saying. Some of it is true.

entries.text: The old mill is haunted by the miller's apprentice
The baron owes money to someone dangerous
Wolves have been seen walking on two legs at night
A ship came in with no crew, only cargo
The well in the square grants wishes, if you give it silver
Someone is buying up all the graveyard plots
The priest was seen meeting a hooded figure at midnight
There is gold in the hills, if you know where to dig
A dragon was seen over the mountains last winter
The new tax collector is not who he says he is

entities.name: Fantasy people
entities.description: A quick person to meet: who they are and what stands out.

entries.text: A tired farmer.
A cheerful guard.
A sharp-eyed merchant.
A young scholar.
An old soldier.
A wandering priest.

entities.name: Quirks
entities.description: One thing that makes a person stand out.

entries.text: Hums when nervous
Never makes eye contact
Collects buttons
Laughs too loudly
Speaks in proverbs
Is missing two fingers and tells a different story each time
Always eating something
Is very polite and very rude in the same sentence
Wears far too much perfume
Keeps a pet mouse in a pocket
Whispers everything
Hates the colour green
Tells everyone about their dreams
Is terrified of birds
Counts things out loud
Has a scar they are proud of
Owes money to everyone
Asks a question in answer to every question
Quotes a famous poet badly
Is always cold

entities.name: Trinkets
entities.description: A small odd thing found in a pocket, a drawer or a pile of bones.

entries.text: A key with no lock to fit it
A tooth with a word carved on it
A tin soldier with one leg
A pressed flower in wax paper
A ring too small for any finger
A letter that was never sent
A glass eye
A tiny bell that makes no sound
A map of a town that does not exist
A wooden coin
A lock of silver hair tied with red thread
A dice that always rolls six for its owner
A seashell that smells of smoke
A child's drawing of a monster
A brass compass that points west
A broken mirror shard
A stone that is always warm
A recipe for soup in an unknown language
A feather as long as an arm
A candle stub that relights itself once
